message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crimes based on facts. The case: officials facilitating illegal high school exam registration, accepting bribes, forging documents (fake school and police seals), making false academic and household certificates. Crimes likely: accepting bribes (受贿), abuse of power for personal gain (maybe “徇私舞弊罪” which is “accepting bribes and abusing position to facilitate illegal admission” – the term used is “招收学生徇私舞弊罪” maybe “非法收取学生报名费” but Chinese criminal law: “徇私舞弊罪” (abuse of public power for personal gain, causing admission to schools etc). Also forging state documents: “伪造国家机关公文罪”. So list: 受贿;徇私舞弊罪;伪造国家机关公文罪. In examples they sometimes combine as "受贿;徇私舞弊罪;伪造国家机关公文罪". The format: [罪名]受贿;徇私舞弊罪;伪造国家机关公文罪<eoa>. Provide reasoning JSON.
